name: mimg_edit_image
description: Edit an existing image with a text instruction (image-to-image) and save the result to the gallery as a new generation. Requires `model` — an id from mimg_list_models whose `modes` include 'image-to-image'; a text-to-image-only model is refused before anything is billed — plus `prompt` (what to change, e.g. 'make it night, keep the composition') and ONE source: `source_image_id` (an image id from mimg_generate_image / mimg_list_generations — the cheapest and most common case, no upload needed), `upload_id` (from mimg_upload_image, for a local file), or `image_url` (a publicly readable URL). Optional: `negative_prompt`, `num_images` (1-8, EACH billed), `image_size`, `seed`, `guidance_scale`. Returns the new generation with per-image `id`, `url`, `seed`, and the `credits` charged. SPENDS real credits, premium only. On a TIMEOUT do not retry — recover with mimg_list_generations.

model.description: Model id from mimg_list_models with 'image-to-image' in its modes.

prompt.description: The edit instruction — what should change.

source_image_id.description: Id of an image already in the gallery to edit. Preferred: no upload, no URL.

upload_id.description: An upload id from mimg_upload_image, when the source is a local file.

image_url.description: A publicly readable image URL, when the source is neither of the above.

num_images.description: How many variants to produce (1-8, default 1). Each is billed.
